# High-resolution inventory icons

Five transparent 512 × 512 WebP illustrations, redrawn from the original GUMPS.VGA inventory symbols and the supplied game screenshots:

- `flaming-sword.webp` — upright silver sword with the original red and gold flames
- `dove.webp` — dove
- `heart.webp` — health heart
- `halo.webp` — the unselected flat gray oval ring
- `halo-selected.webp` — its yellow selected state; use when the player clicks the ring
- `save-disk.webp` — large, old-style square floppy disk with blue label and metal shutter

These are artwork files only. They do not change item hit areas or game behavior. Iolo's dialogue portrait is installed at `../portraits/faces/1.webp` (the face ID the game uses) and `../portraits/iolo.webp`, both at the same 512 × 768 dimensions as the existing portrait set.
